stayType: Club campsite with touring and tent pitches
accommodation: Grass and hardstanding pitches with or without electric, jumbo grass pitches and fully serviced hardstandings; tents, trailer tents, rooftop tents, caravans and motorhomes accepted
suitableFor: Tent campers, caravanners, motorhome owners, families and dog owners
parking: Not described; site is off the A39 with no roadside footpaths, so a car is needed
dogs: Pets welcome; no dedicated dog walk on site
beachAccess: Bude's beaches and surf spots about 5–15 minutes by car (club site page)
confirmedFeatures: Toilets and showers, accessible facilities, Wi-Fi, shop, children's play area, recreation hall, parent and baby room, laundry, dishwashing, gas, ice-pack freezing, grey water disposal and chemical disposal point
overview: This Camping and Caravanning Club site sits just off the A39 outside Bude, with grass and hardstanding pitches for tents, caravans and motorhomes. Bude's beaches and surf spots are a short drive away rather than walkable, as the surrounding roads have no footpaths.
surfTripFit: A straightforward, well-equipped pitch base for surfers with their own transport; it is not within walking distance of the beach.
